query.selection: REG live pass/run rows; exclude kneels, spikes and two-point attempts. Designed runs exclude observed dropbacks and scrambles; scrambles require qb_dropback/pass_attempt classification plus qb_scramble=true and rush_attempt=true. Failed QB escapes recorded as sacks are not successful scrambles. This is realized action, not hidden designed-call intent.
query.outcome: Primary clean outcome requires penalty=false AND finite whole-play yards_gained. Keep all live flagged/missing-penalty populations and missing gains in audit. No-play penalties excluded by live selection remain audited separately, not silently counted as successful runs. No accepted/enforced-penalty reconstruction. Individual rushing_yards audited separately from whole-play gain.
query.yardSuccess: Chosen yard-based40/60/100 rule: gain >=40% ydstogo on first,60% on second,100% third/fourth; only valid down1-4 and positive finite distance. Not a universalNFL standard; include45/60/100 sensitivity. Preserve yard-only success on turnovers; successWithoutLostFumble separately needs known fumble_lost=false. PositiveEPA uses finite provider nflfastR expected-points-model EPA, distinct from yard success and immediate conversion.
query.conversion: Separate gain>=ydstogo; gain>=ydstogo without known lost fumble; recorded first_down_rush OR rush_touchdown with both flags known. No missing flag becomes false.
query.distribution: Whole-play gain; interpolated p10/25/50/75/90/95/99, max; bins negative,zero,positiveUnder4,4toUnder7,7toUnder10,10toUnder15,15toUnder20,20toUnder30,30toUnder40,40plus. Stuff<=0 differs from negative<0. Each tail's share of net gained yards and positive gained yards is a separate composition diagnostic, not an event rate. Report excess beyond threshold and upper-capped mean10/20 preserving losses, not truncated/excluded-tail mean.
query.tails: Separate10/15/20/30/40+ all-clean-gain frequencies. Field-eligible rates require valid yardline_100>=threshold; excluded short fields and unknown fields counted. TD at goal is a geometrically censored endpoint, not evidence the run could/could not continue. No invented latent yardage; retain short-field TDs.
query.carrier: Exact season roster gsis_id + listed position: RB_FB/QB/other/unknown. Conflicts remain unknown, no name matching. Position is not snap role. Sneak only positive/negative available FTN is_qb_sneak chart; missing charting unavailable, not false.
query.situations: Joint down×distance×field per carrier/run-kind and per season. Distance1/2to3/4to6/7to10/11to19/20plus; fieldgoalLine1to5/redZone6to20/plus21to50/own51to89/backedUp90to100. ScorelargeTrailing17plus/trailing9to16/trailing1to8/tied/leading1to8/leading9to16/largeLeading17plus; clockearlyRegulation/last10to2min/final2min/overtime; margins and score×clock, not giant all-variable cross.
query.chart: Exact game/play join to available FTN, with per-season missingness. Known positive integer1-11 box<=5/6/7/8plus; observed zero labelledzeroUnverified separately, not inferred zero defenders/lightbox. Actual number of offense backfield players (not11/12personnel), qb_location, starting_hash, motionbeforeORatsnap,RPO,trick,sneak. No charted blocking concept or named defensive front inferred. FTN and derived charted aggregates attributed CC-BY-SA-4.0.
query.cohorts: Declared ordinaryRB_FB: designed run,RB/FB,down1/2,distance8-10,outside20,scorewithin8,regulationbeforelast600s. Also allRB_FB, shortYardageLateDown (down3/4,1-2), goalLine (field1-5), third20plus, final2minLeading9plus, positivechartedSneak, and scramble. These are observational selected jobs, not causal treatment effects.
query.bootstrap: Season-stratified GAME-cluster percentile bootstrap, identical shared deterministic draws across strata. Sample each season's full live-game universe with replacement, retaining both teams and all selected plays from a sampled game; cells absent in a sampled game contribute zero. 95% percentile intervals require each metric's own denominator and games-with-known-denominator to meet declared exposure minima. Does not make games across repeated teams independent or give synthetic-roster tolerance bands. Under10 observed events flaggedrare; zero-event [0,0] only describes resampling observed games, not proofzero-risk or an unseen-event upper bound.
query.variation: Observed team-season and defense-team-season distributions retain gain and game exposure; do not confuse their across-team spread with uncertainty, isolated talent, causal scheme effect or generated-roster hardlimits.
query.standardization: Reference2022/23 versus holdout2024/25 common weights within kind×carrier×down×distance×field cells with >=30 clean gains per period; score leading9plus versus trailing9plus within season×kind×carrier×down×distance×field×clock with >=20 clean gains per group. Metric-specific denominators required and common weighting uses their summed denominators. Report excluded mass; common-support descriptive comparison, no causal score/box effect.
query.fallback: Lookup never averages thin exact rows: exact >=100 gains/>=20games else broaden by removing field, then distance, then down, retaining kind/carrier. A broader supported row is context-broader reference and reports discarded dimensions; no invented tiny-cell target. If none qualify return unavailable.
query.limitations: PBP cannot identify blocking force, grip, footing, contact timing, called front, inside/outside zone, gap exchange, particular run technique or causal counterfactual. Final outcome mismatches nominate film/first-transition diagnosis, not automatic strength or traction tuning. EPA is model-derived and engine adapter need not fabricate it.
